title: Bayalu Dari
desc: Gopu, a womaniser, falls in love with Chandra, a rich heiress, and decides to mend his ways by joining the army. However, she is devastated after he is declared dead in a plane crash.

title: Hatamari Hennu Kiladi Gandu
desc: Stuck in a loveless marriage, an arrogant woman suspects her husband of infidelity and humiliates his alleged mistress.

title: Bhoopathi Ranga
desc: Bhaskar, who runs away from home as a child, begins a new life in the city as Bhoopathi Ranga. Years later, he returns home but finds his mother dead and sister banished from the village.

title: Sakkath Risk
desc: A trip into the forest turns grim when a vengeful spirit targets a group of unsuspecting friends, testing their courage as fear takes over and secrets slowly unravel.

title: Aalemane
desc: When Bhaira's wife is found dead, the villagers accuse him of killing and raping her. In a bid to prove his innocence, he enlists the help of a teacher and strives to uncover the truth.
